records.text: Candace Owens said the show confirmed that some Catholic funeral homes offer cremation services despite Catholic doctrine opposing cremation.

appearances.snippet: There is there are Catholic funeral homes that do offer cremation services. It is positively wild to me, but we were able to confirm that and I don't have an answer for as to why that is, but you are correct on the doctrine.

verification.notes: Catholic institutions in Arizona do offer and accommodate cremation services, so that portion is supported. The characterization of Catholic doctrine as opposing cremation is overstated: canon law recommends burial but expressly does not prohibit cremation unless chosen for reasons contrary to Christian doctrine, and Vatican guidance states cremation is not opposed per se to Christianity. The statement combines a true service claim with an inaccurate doctrinal premise.
